### Daily in Your Presence - July 22
Author: Rebecca Barlow Jordan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/dailypresence/daily-in-your-presence-july-22-1408740.html
Passage: Mark 14:60-61
Points:
- Jesus intimately understands the pain of verbal hostility, rejection, and unfair ridicule.
- Faced with aggressive interrogation and false accusations, Jesus chose restraint and purposeful silence instead of angry defense.
- Because He was secure in His divine identity and redemptive mission, He did not engage in self-promotion.
- Believers facing hostility can rely on the Lord for wisdom and strength to remain steadfast.
- Responding with selfless restraint allows truth and character to ultimately shine through unjust treatment.

### Jesus Answers His Accusers
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
Passage: Matthew 26:64
Points:
- After keeping silent before false testimony, Jesus broke His silence under solemn oath to declare Himself the Christ.
- By claiming a seat at the right hand of Power, Jesus claimed the divine authority and status of God Himself.
- The Jewish council rejected His claim because their desire to protect their own position blinded them to the truth.
- The physical abuse inflicted on Christ was used by God's providence to restore the divine image marred by human sin.
- Christians should remember the costly sacrifice of their Savior and strive to reflect the true image of God.
